note: Gradient lab tiny model. The one-layer model is the Reading's running model (src/read/recompute.py: x = (2, 1), W, target sat). The two-layer model is the lab's own extension for backprop, chosen so its logits are also exactly (2, 1, 0).

one_layer.doc: same as the Reading: x is the embedding of the context "the cat"; z = W x

two_layer.doc: a = W1 x, h = relu(a), z = W2 h, L = -log softmax(z)[sat]; the third hidden unit is off (a = -1), so its gradient is blocked
